name: Long YouTube videos
description: Use when editing a long video (8 to 60 minutes): read the story first, cut scene by scene, keep the picture changing at a steady pace, write chapters from the story, and take notes per scene.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.
